versions.content: If a certificate is received with the certificate or certificateVerify handshake message of TLS it shall be provided to the Key Manager using the function KeyM_SetCertificate with the reference TcpIpTlsCipherKeyMRemoteCertificate of TcpIpTlsConnection. Afterwards, the certificate is verified using the function KeyM_VerifyCertificate() or, if more than one certificate has been received with the handshake message, with the function KeyM_VerifyCertificateChain(). This function also uses the TcpIpTlsCipherKeyMRemoteCertificate reference.
